_note: Federal monthly routines for the competence month M, due in month M+1 unless stated. Review every year: due dates and rolling rules change by regulation.

rules.name: PGDAS-D and DAS (Simples Nacional)
rules.source: Resolução CGSN 140/2018, art. 40: day 20; if no banking day, the next business day

rules.name: eSocial periodic events (payroll closing)
rules.source: eSocial guidance manual: day 15; postponed to the next business day

rules.name: EFD-Reinf
rules.source: Day 15 of the following month (check the current IN for rolling)

rules.name: FGTS Digital
rules.source: Lei 8.036/1990, art. 15: day 20; anticipated when not a business day

rules.name: INSS and payroll IRRF (DARF from DCTFWeb)
rules.source: Federal DARF: day 20, anticipated when not a business day

rules.name: DCTFWeb filing
rules.source: IN RFB 2.248/2025: last business day of the following month

rules.name: PIS/COFINS
rules.source: Day 25 of the following month, anticipated when not a business day

rules.name: IRPJ/CSLL (quarterly)
rules.source: Quarterly tax: last business day of the month after the quarter ends
